enablePostgresUser.title: Enable "postgres" admin user
enablePostgresUser.description: Assign a password to the "postgres" admin user. Otherwise, remote access will be blocked for this user

postgresPassword.title: Password for the "postgres" admin user
postgresPassword.description: Defaults to a random 10-character alphanumeric string if not set

database.title: PostgreSQL custom database
database.description: Name of the custom database to be created during the 1st initialization of PostgreSQL

username.title: PostgreSQL custom user
username.description: Name of the custom user to be created during the 1st initialization of PostgreSQL. This user only has permissions on the PostgreSQL custom database

password.title: Password for the custom user to create
password.description: Defaults to a random 10-character alphanumeric string if not set

replicationUsername.title: PostgreSQL replication user
replicationUsername.description: Name of user used to manage replication.

replicationPassword.title: Password for PostgreSQL replication user
replicationPassword.description: Defaults to a random 10-character alphanumeric string if not set

enabled.title: Enable Init Containers
enabled.description: Change the owner of the persist volume mountpoint to RunAsUser:fsGroup
